contact.department: New Castle County Government, Office of Land Use / GIS (NCCDE)

counties.notes: New Castle County DE (Wilmington/Newark metro; county seat Wilmington; FIPS 10003; most populous of Delaware's 3 counties, pop. ~570,000) publishes a public ArcGIS MapServer parcel layer hosted by NCCDE GIS (Foundation/Base_Layers/MapServer/0, 'Parcels', ~203,753 features, no token required). Key fields: PRCLID (parcel ID / APN), CNTCTLAST (owner last name / contact, the searchable owner field), OWNADDR (owner mailing address), ADDRESS (property situs address). Owner-name search via UPPER(CNTCTLAST) LIKE UPPER('%NAME%') works. Verified 2026-06-20: UPPER(CNTCTLAST) LIKE UPPER('%SMITH%') returns Wilmington-area parcels. Delaware has only 3 counties (New Castle, Kent, Sussex); Kent and Sussex are served separately. Do not confuse with New Castle in Pennsylvania (Lawrence County, PA).
